kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أجتذب (form VIII)
# أَجْتَذِبُ (ʔajtaḏibu) /ʔad͡ʒ.ta.ði.bu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِجْتَذَبَ (ijtaḏaba)
# أُجْتَذَبُ (ʔujtaḏabu) /ʔud͡ʒ.ta.ða.bu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِجْتَذَبَ (ijtaḏaba)
# أَجْتَذِبَ (ʔajtaḏiba) /ʔad͡ʒ.ta.ði.ba/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِجْتَذَبَ (ijtaḏaba)
# أُجْتَذَبَ (ʔujtaḏaba) /ʔud
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
